_note: Pieces Nebula downloads only when a machine or a guided setup needs them, never inside the installers (the owner's 2026-10-27 word: "keep the downloads as small as possible"; "we are transparent when adding guided setups we download the other pieces"). Each is a release file, checked against its sha256 here; whoever downloads one says what it is, how big, and why. Filled in by the release (docs/DEVELOPING.md); a platform with no sha256 is not published yet.

impulse-portable.label: Impulse portable
impulse-portable.why: the runtime for Halo and your models on a machine without an NVIDIA card (a Radeon or another card through Vulkan, else the CPU)

impulse-flashnext.label: Impulse Flash-Next
impulse-flashnext.why: the engine for Qwen3.8 Flash-Next models (impulse-fx and its engine library)
